summary: PennantPark Private Income Fund, a Delaware-registered closed-end interval fund (BDC-type, file 814-01920), filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure) and Item 9.01 to announce a monthly cash distribution. On October 5, 2026, the Company declared $0.175 per share, payable October 29, 2026 to shareholders of record as of October 22, 2026, funded from taxable net investment income, with final tax characteristics reported on Form 1099-DIV in early 2027. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor, transaction terms, or regulatory clock is present; this is ordinary capital-return housekeeping.
